key_findings: LJA5 is a novel population of prodynorphin-expressing GABAergic neurons in the lateral pons that projects selectively to spinal lamina I.

Chemogenetic activation of LJA5 neurons reduces capsaicin-induced pain, mechanical hypersensitivity and histamine-induced itch without altering thermal preference, reflexive thermal pain or ambulation.
